# Christina Clement (President of the United States, Georgia, candidate 2024)

From Ballotpedia

Jump to: [navigation](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#mw-navigation), [search](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#p-search)

Christina Clement (State of Loc Nation Party) ran for election to President of the United States in Georgia on November 5, 2024.[\[1\]](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#footnote-1)

## Elections

### 2024

#### Ballotpedia survey responses

See also: [Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection](https://ballotpedia.org/Ballotpedia%27s_Candidate_Connection)

[![Candidate Connection](https://cdn.ballotpedia.org/images/8/88/Candidate_Connection_Logo.png)](https://ballotpedia.org/Ballotpedia%27s_Candidate_Connection)

Christina Clement completed [Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection](https://ballotpedia.org/Ballotpedia%27s_Candidate_Connection) survey in 2023. The survey questions appear in bold and are followed by Clement's responses. Candidates are asked three required questions for this survey, but they may answer additional optional questions as well.

Expand all \| Collapse all

[Who are you? Tell us about yourself.](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse-bio--)

I am President Candidate Christina Clement, the voice of the voiceless and of a voice. I was born in Brooklyn, raised in the Bronx and have lived in several states to share in the experiences of those around me. For 21+24 years I have observed and heard many concerns of my neighbors as well as experienced our system in America and have noted it’s flaws that are affecting the American people. Time to repair and fulfill the broken promises. Throughout my campaign I will address your concerns some popular and some silent issues that actually are the root to the major issues. It’s time to clean up America

[Please list below 3 key messages of your campaign. What are the main points you want voters to remember about your goals for your time in office?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse-key-message--)

- I am focused on the solution not the promises
- I am truly for the people as a living example
- Read Revealed the Kingdom of LOCs Nazirite vow continues Volume 2

[What areas of public policy are you personally passionate about?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse2--)

Right is Right across the board

[What organizations or individuals have endorsed your campaign?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse3--)

State of Loc Nation, pending others. Open to others

[What was your very first job? How long did you have it?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse4--)

My very first job was tutoring my class mates during after school in elementary school.

[What is the first historical event that happened in your lifetime that you remember? How old were you at the time?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse5--)

September 11 Attack, 22 years young

[Who do you look up to? Whose example would you like to follow, and why?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse6--)

Jesus as my role model because he loves the people like I do. God as my lead and best friend. Once I submitted to the lead of the most high I have been lead to supernatural success for all.

[What characteristics or principles are most important for an elected official?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse7--)

Authentic, humility, visionary, courage and a drive for progress and completion.

[What do you believe are the core responsibilities for someone elected to this office?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse8--)

The duties outlined according to the benefit of the people. I am that I am. A messenger of GOD and of service to the people.

[Is there a book, essay, film, or something else you would recommend to someone who wants to understand your political philosophy?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse9--)

1\. Revealed the kingdom of Locs Nazirite Vow Continues Volume 1 & 2

2\. Locs linked to Spirituality

3\. Ancestor Speaks Journal: write to GOD

[What qualities do you possess that you believe would make you a successful officeholder?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse10--)

Visionary, solutions driven, humility, love for people. God validated

[What legacy would you like to leave?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse11--)

The fulfillment of all past promises. Removing systematic oppression, releasing the financial strain of the people.

[What is something that has been a struggle in your life?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse12--)

Vagrancy laws, systematic oppression, black code and discrimination against Locs. Locs is our artifact of faith.

[What was the last song that got stuck in your head?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse13--)

Tasha Cobbs Your Spirit; Marvin Snapp, The best in me;
Desmond Champion Relaxation

[What is your favorite book? Why?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse14--)

The Bible as the framework and Revealed the Kingdom of locs Nazirite Cow continues Volume 1 and 2 speaks on our Loc history

[Tell us your favorite joke.](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse15--)

I like documentaries more than jokes. However when I do entertain jokes my go to is Martin, Kevin Hart and Dave Chappelle. N/A

[If you could be any fictional character, who would you want to be?](https://ballotpedia.org/Christina_Clement_(President_of_the_United_States,_Georgia,_candidate_2024)#collapse16--)

N/A

If the candidate disagrees with an edit, he or she may request the full removal of the survey response from Ballotpedia.org. Ballotpedia does not edit or correct typographical errors unless the candidate's campaign requests it._
